name: ix
description: IX's MCP server: its ML, math, graph, search and Demerzel governance tools. Needs Node.js and an ix-mcp binary, found from the ix_mcp_bin option, IX_MCP_BIN or PATH

ix_mcp_bin.title: ix-mcp binary
ix_mcp_bin.description: Path to ix-mcp. Leave empty to use IX_MCP_BIN, then ix-mcp on PATH

ix_root.title: IX clone
ix_root.description: An ix clone with governance/demerzel checked out. Leave empty to use IX_ROOT, then the clone ix-mcp was built in
